item.title: Why THE LORD OF THE RINGS: THE FELLOWSHIP OF THE RING Was Almost Never Made
item.description: For decades, The Lord of the Rings sat on a strange pedestal in Hollywood. Revered, feared, and endlessly discussed, but never fully embraced.
